programme.title: Ariel
programme.desc: Ariel kertoo Taistosta (Turo Pajala, Hamlet liikemaailmassa), pohjoissuomalaisesta kaivosmiehestä. Kun kaivos suljetaan, Taisto kääntää Cadillacin keulan kohti etelää. Helsingissä Taisto asuu Pelastusarmeijan yömajassa, etsii työtä ja rakastuu uutteraan yksinhuoltajaäitiin.

programme.title: Varjoja paratiisissa
programme.desc: Varjoja paratiisissa kertoo roskakuskin ja supermarketin kassan rakkaustarinan. Se kertoo ihmisistä kadun varjoisalla puolella, mutta myös itsekunnioituksesta ja rakkauden välttämättömyydestä.

programme.title: Van Veeteren - Carambole
programme.desc: Mies törmää autollaan 14-vuotiaaseen poikaan, joka saa surmansa välittömästi. Tapahtuma-aikana on pimeää ja sateista, ja mies pakenee onnettomuuspaikalta. Tämä on virhe, jota hän tulee katumaan katkerasti, ja joka muuttaa hänen koko elämänsä.

programme.title: 6 Juni
programme.desc: Samira on kaunis 24-vuotias nainen. Hänen perheensä on luvannut hänet vaimoksi miehelle, jota hän ei rakasta. Jos Samira ei suostu avioliittoon, häntä uhkaa kunniamurha.

programme.title: Over The Edge
programme.desc: David ja Freja ovat mielettömän rakastuneita ja muuttavat unelmataloonsa Mønin saarelle. Pian idylli särkyy selittämättömän itsemurhan jälkeen. David päättää selvittää mysteerin, mutta mitä lähemmäs totuutta hän pääsee, sitä kauemmas hän etääntyy Frejasta.

programme.title: Mies vailla menneisyyttä
programme.desc: Mies vailla menneisyyttä kertoo muistinsa menettävästä miehestä, joka aloittaa elämänsä alusta yhteiskunnan köyhimpien keskellä. Mies vailla menneisyyttä sai Cannesin elokuvajuhlien Grand Prix -palkinnon ja Kati Outinen palkittiin roolisuorituksestaan parhaan naisnäyttelijän palkinnolla.

programme.title: Horizon Line
programme.desc: Ex-pariskunta tapaa vuosien jälkeen osallistuessaan hyvän ystävänsä häihin. Heidän lentäessään trooppiselle saarelle valtameren yli pienellä, yksimoottorisella lentokoneella, pilotti saa kohtalokkaan sydänkohtauksen.

programme.title: Lindell - Hunajasyötti - Osa 1
programme.desc: On kesä. Elena Bukotaite - jäätelötehtaalla työskentelevä liettualaisnainen - ajetaan autolla kuoliaaksi. Samaan aikaan poliisi etsii 8-vuotiasta Høvikissä kadonnutta poikaa. Wiggo Nyman ajaa jäätelöautoa alueella. Hän oli myös Elenan miesystävä. Liittyvätkö tapaukset toisiinsa?

programme.title: Viking Blood
programme.desc: Ryöstöretkellä ollessaan Tor-viikinki joutuu yllättäen keskelle vuosituhannen sotaa, jota käyvät vanhat ja uudet aasajumalat. Tor päättää, ettei yksikään heistä ansaitse voittoa ja valtaherruutta.

programme.title: Van Veeteren: Pääsky, kissa, ruusu, kuolema
programme.desc: Van Veeteren –elokuvat perustuvat Håkan Nesserin menestysromaaneihin.

programme.title: Lindell - Orkesterimonttu - Osa 1
programme.desc: Elämänsä parhaan esityksen jälkeen oopperassa ensiviulisti Siv Ellen Blad murhataan julmasti. Rikoskomisario Cato Isaksen saa nopeasti selville, että hän oli joutunut postiryöstön kohteeksi. Piileekö siinä yhteys?

programme.title: Ykköset Ja Nollat - Osa 2
programme.desc: Kriitikoiden ylistämä brutaali gangsteridraama Johan Renckiltä! FBI ja Interpol saavat vihiä suuresta luottokorttisotkusta, ja narkkari Sebbe napataan kiinni epäiltynä. Poliisin aloittaessa kuulustelun he saavat kuulla uskomattoman tarinan Göteborgin alamaailmasta.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Mies vailla menneisyyttä
programme.desc: Mies vailla menneisyyttä kertoo muistinsa menettävästä miehestä, joka aloittaa elämänsä alusta yhteiskunnan köyhimpien keskellä. Mies vailla menneisyyttä sai Cannesin elokuvajuhlien Grand Prix -palkinnon ja Kati Outinen palkittiin roolisuorituksestaan parhaan naisnäyttelijän palkinnolla.

programme.title: Ruotsalainen Avioliitto
programme.desc: Erland on töissä pikkupaikkakunnan paperitehtaassa parhaan ystävänsä Sven-Erikin kanssa. Vapaa-aikana hän pitää seurakunnan avioliittokoulua yhdessä vaimonsa Mayn kanssa. Eräissä juhlissa Erland rakastuu tulisesti Sven-Erikin vaimoon Kariniin.

programme.title: Kauas pilvet karkaavat
programme.desc: Kauas pilvet karkaavat kertoo helsinkiläispariskunnasta. Raitiovaununkuljettaja ja perinteikkään ravintola Dubrovnikin hovimestari menettävät työnsä, mutta eivät toivoaan Aki Kaurismäen (Le Havre) Suomi-trilogian ensimmäisessä osassa.

programme.title: I Miss You
programme.desc: Identtiset kaksoset Cilla jaTina ovat hyvin läheiset mutta samalla valtavan erilaiset. Cilla on taiteilijasielu ja idealisti, joka kulkee omia teitään, kun taas Tina on suosittu, puberteettinen ja jatkuvasti rakastunut.

programme.title: Original
programme.desc: Henry on elämän kalpea kopio. Nuori pankkivirkailija yrittää niin innokkaasti sopeutua muiden odotuksiin, että hän on jo kauan sitten kadottanut itsensä. Sitten Jon ilmestyy tyhjästä ja houkuttelee Henryn lähtemään mukaan Espanjaan avaamaan aidon bodegan.

programme.title: Zombie ja kummitusjuna
programme.desc: Zombie on oman tiensä kulkija, joka ei pysty noudattamaan suomalaisen yhteiskunnan hänelle asettamia normeja. Zombie päättää jättää kaiken ja suunnata ulkomaille - paikkaan jossa kukaan ei odota häneltä mitään. Zombie ja kummitusjuna kuuluu monien mielestä Mika Kaurismäen elokuvien parhaimmistoon.

programme.title: Call of the Unseen
programme.desc: Nuori taideopiskelija menettää uskonsa luoviin kykyihinsä. Oppilaan vanhahkoa opettajaa kiusaavat synkät mielikuvat, joita hänen kolkot maalauksensa herättävät. Heidän kohtalonsa kietoutuvat yhteen seikkailurikkaalla matkalla, jonka varrella he haluavat löytää itsensä.

programme.title: Team Albert
programme.desc: Tee mitä haluat. Lukiolainen Albert ottaa hyvää tarkoittavan neuvon kirjaimellisesti. Yliopistoon meneminen lukion jälkeen ja sen jälkeen toimistotyön saaminen ei yksinkertaisesti ole se, miten hän kuvittelee tulevaisuutensa.

programme.title: On The Edge
programme.desc: Laittomat katuajot, alkoholi ja vauhdikkaat suhteet pitävät asiat mielenkiintoisina levottomille ja adrenaliinia janoaville kaveruksille. Yhdistelmä osoittautuu kuitenkin hengenvaaralliseksi, kun Nikolaj ja hänen paras ystävänsä Martin aiheuttavat nuoren tytön kuoleman katuajoissa.

programme.title: Akvaariorakkaus
programme.desc: Anna-Leena Härkösen menestysromaaniin perustuva elokuva itseään etsivästä Saarasta ja Jonista (Nicke Lignell), joka yrittää tehdä kaikkensa auttaakseen Saaraa, mutta tehtävä osoittautuu mahdottomaksi.

programme.title: Rebounce
programme.desc: Rebounce on tanskalainen draama teini-ikäisestä Louisesta, joka asuu isovanhempiensa luona, koska hänen äitinsä on vankilassa. Kun äiti yllättäen vapautuu, alkaa Louise salaa pitää yhteyttä äitiinsä ja ihannoida tätä sokeasti.

programme.title: Jimmy Jones
programme.desc: Hyväsydäminen pikkurikollinen Jimmy Jones Malmöstä yrittää tienata rutkasti rahaa. Hän toimii välikätenä huumekaupassa, jota käyvät hollantilainen huumesyndikaatti ja Tukholmassa oleskeleva serbialainen pokerinpelaaja Dragan.

programme.title: Lindell - Hunajasyötti - Osa 1
programme.desc: On kesä. Elena Bukotaite - jäätelötehtaalla työskentelevä liettualaisnainen - ajetaan autolla kuoliaaksi. Samaan aikaan poliisi etsii 8-vuotiasta Høvikissä kadonnutta poikaa. Wiggo Nyman ajaa jäätelöautoa alueella. Hän oli myös Elenan miesystävä. Liittyvätkö tapaukset toisiinsa?

programme.desc: TOIVON TUOLLA PUOLEN kertoo hiililaivalla Helsinkiin rantautuvasta Khaledista (Sherwan Haji), Syyrian sodan pakolaisesta, joka etsii matkalla kadonnutta sisartaan.

programme.title: Room to Improve

programme.title: Ashes To Ashes
programme.desc: Upon returning to work following Gina Blunt's arrest, Jane and Grayson are representing Kathy Kelton, who is suing her late fiancé Scott Richards' stepmother Caitlin over custody of his cremated remains. Though the case looks weak after Scott's sister testifies that Kathy is eating her fiancé's ashes, a sympathetic Grayson presses Jane to continue. Meanwhile, when Parker reveals that he secretly allowed the FBI to use the firm to nab Gina, Kim is angry over being kept in the dark about the sting. And as Jane starts to accept that Owen's sudden disappearance means that he's left her for another woman, she's surprised when he suddenly returns. When Kathy says that eating his ashes allows her to see Scott's ghost, Jane wonders if she would be better off getting psychological rather than legal help. But after Kathy collapses in the courtroom, she's found to be suffering from heavy metal poisoning. After tests indicate that Kathy was poisoned by a deadly chemical she ingested by eating Scott's remains, Grayson suspects that Caitlin used the substance to murder her stepson in order to inherit the $20 million he was about to receive from his father's estate. When he finally convinces Jane to listen to what he has to say, Owen explains his disappearance by revealing that he was getting checked out at the Mayo Clinic when he had a heart attack that left him in a coma for weeks. But while Jane wants to pick up where they left off, concerns about his health cause Owen to withdraw his marriage proposal. After Teri is declared the winner of a song contest, she asks Luke for a loan to finance a recording. When he looks into the record company, however, Luke discovers that Teri is the target of a con man. And when Luke takes her to a performance given by another of the contest winners, Teri learns the truth about the con. Finally, though Caitlin has already disposed of Scott's ashes, Jane tricks her into revealing what she did by claiming that Kathy kept some of the remains

programme.title: Lady Parts
programme.desc: As Jane tries to avoid aggravating Owen's heart condition, Deb's mother Bobbie Dobkins is being sued for an injury sustained by her dance student, Kiera Walsh. As she's meeting with Kiera's mom Megan, Jane is unhappy to learn that Bobbie's insurance company has assigned the pushy and annoying lawyer Simon Grundy to represent its interests. Meanwhile, Grayson's high school classmate Fiona Krupp hires him when the city of Lakewood refuses to pay her for a sculpture it commissioned and now claims is obscene. And when Luke seeks her advice about buying concert tickets for a date, Stacy assumes they are for her. Once Kiera testifies that Bobbie made her do a dance move that resulted in what Megan says is a career-ending injury, both Jane and Simon ask Bobbie to consider settling. While Jane gets Megan to consider payment for Kiera's medical costs, Simon insists that she also withdraw the claim for loss of future earnings. So when Bobbie makes matters worse by saying that Kiera would have never made it as a professional dancer, Megan angrily refuses any offer. And when she vindictively amends the lawsuit to include emotional distress, Bobbie looks to strengthen her legal team by firing Jane and hiring Parker. Meanwhile, Grayson proves that Lakewood officials approved Fiona's sketches, and Judge Owen French orders the city to pay her for the finished piece. Although Megan settles with the insurance company for Kiera's medical bills, Bobbie still remains liable for the emotional damage claim. But when Jane finds that Kiera was actually injured while skateboarding before her dance lesson, not only does the jury decide in Bobbie's favor, but the insurance company fires Simon. When Teri organizes a demonstration in support of Fiona's artwork, Owen is inspired to rule that it cannot be altered by the city. And after Fiona admits that she always intended her sculpture to be provocative in order to gain notoriety for her work, she and Grayson start a romantic relationship.

programme.title: Family Matters
programme.desc: With the support of Councilman Mark Phillips, Jane files a lawsuit on behalf of Jenny Evans, a teenager who collapsed at a rave put on by promoter Dennis Fullman. After she receives a death threat against Owen meant to dissuade her from pursuing the case, Jane opts not to tell him for fear of aggravating his heart condition. However, once Owen learns that he's under police protection and insists Jane continue with the suit, things get tougher when Jenny's friend Carla admits that they took ecstasy before the rave. Meanwhile, when Owen hesitates to invite his father to their wedding, Jane asks Stacy to investigate. After donating his sperm to Carrie Renner, Dan Abraham hires Kim and Grayson when Carrie and her new fiancé Rick Keller insist that he relinquish his parental rights. Though Keller has Dan arrested for illegally trafficking in human tissue, the case is dropped after Kim demands that anyone who engaged in a privately arranged sperm donation also be prosecuted. And when Keller accuses Dan of violating a state law that prohibits gay men from being sperm donors, Kim's contention that the government has no business dictating how people choose to get pregnant prompts Carrie to leave her bullying fiancé and negotiate visitation rights for Dan. When Jenny dies, both her mother and Carla insist that Jane pursue her case. After an autopsy shows that Jenny died from dehydration and not a drug overdose, Jane and Owen discover that the water fountains in the Coliseum were turned off, leaving the 30,000 attendees to buy bottled water from a company owned by none other than Councilman Phillips. And once Jane finds proof that he's behind the threat against Owen, Phillips is arrested for Jenny's death. Finally, Owen admits that his reluctance over the invitation stems from his disapproval of his father's recent wedding. But as Owen reconciles with his dad, Jane resists telling him the truth about her identity.

programme.title: Pick's And Pakes
programme.desc: Alleging that Vanden Pharmaceuticals' antidepressant Aprox caused his client Sheila Reese to miscarry, celebrity trial lawyer Lawrence Brand arranges for Jane to help in his lawsuit. When Brand shows up late for the first day of the trial, Jane is on her own after Vanden's lawyers reveal that Sheila had been taking a dangerous painkiller while she was pregnant. And after she can't find documents that Brand claims are in the case file, Jane worries about his mental state when he becomes disoriented during his courtroom presentation. Meanwhile, Jane hesitates to tell Stacy that she'll be moving out once she and Owen find a house. Enlisting Grayson's help when Jonah Pierce claims he owns the patent on the pake, Stacy realizes that the one person who can back up her story is her ex-business partner and con artist Nikki LePree. Finding her in jail under another name, Grayson offers to keep Nikki's identity a secret in exchange for photos that prove Stacy invented the pake. But when they fail to convince the judge, Stacy and Grayson challenge Jonah to a bake-off to establish who's telling the truth. Meanwhile, when Luke decides to advance his relationship with Kim, he's surprised when she suddenly claims that she doesn't want to see him anymore. Tracking down Brand's ex-wife, Jane learns that he has a degenerative brain condition known as Pick's disease. When confronted with the truth, Brand agrees to let Jane take the lead in the lawsuit, but not before falsely claiming he has proof that Vanden knew about the dangers of Aprox. So with Owen's encouragement, Jane makes it appear as though she actually has the study's results, forcing a Vanden executive to freeze up on the witness stand. And when the company agrees to settle, Brand credits Jane for salvaging the case before announcing that he is retiring. programme.title: Jane's Getting Married
programme.desc: Though she's diagnosed with a fatal brain tumor, Hannah Baker refuses surgery, preferring to take advantage of the increased intelligence it's given her. Worried that she has only six months to live, her husband Mark asks their old friend Grayson to help change her mind. However, when neuroscientist Bradley Alton convinces her that she could live for many years, Hannah says she's leaving Mark to start a new life. Meanwhile, after her mom comes to help with the wedding, Jane's irritation with her meddling drives Elaine to leave. And as Jane struggles to make amends, she also opens a rift with Grayson after accusing him of not being able to move on from Deb's death. And after Luke inadvertently reveals that Kim is pregnant, she tells Parker that the baby isn't his. After a fan confesses that a song lyric inspired her to cut the brake line in Paige McBride's ex-boyfriend's car, the country singer is accused of soliciting to have him killed. But after Stacy finds evidence that the obsessed fan is lying, she and Kim prove that Chase Black set Paige up in order to sue her for $1 million. Meanwhile, after the judge refuses to treat the Bakers' wedding vows as a legal contract, Jane and Grayson ask Dr. Alton to level with Hannah about her chances. And though Alton refuses, once they discover that he's already scheduled her autopsy for his research, Hannah sees she's been duped and agrees to the surgery after all. After asking her mom to come back and help her get ready for the wedding, Jane realizes that she still has unresolved feelings for Grayson. Watching from heaven, the Old Jane tricks Guardian Angel Fred into letting her return to Earth just as the wedding is getting underway. So when a stuck door conveniently keeps her from walking down the aisle, Grayson comes to the rescue and admits that he only got over Deb's death after falling in love with Jane. programme.title: To Kill An angel
programme.desc: The entire political and law enforcement, hierarchy of a rural town is involved in an extortion-murder scheme which preys on wealthy, young women as Angels in Chains airs on the new series, Charlie's Angels. The half-sister of a missing girl prompts a Charlie's Angels investigation of a country prison farm and a nearby small town sheriff. Kelly and Jill deliberately get arrested for speeding. They are sentenced by a kangaroo court to unusually long terms at the nearby prison-farm. Once there, they discover that the sheriff, prison authorities, and the local County Manager are partners in an extortion-murder scheme. Wealthy young women without relatives are arrested and jailed on trumped-up violations. The women are virtually enslaved until they sign over all their assets in exchange for an early release and then killed. Those inquiring further are told that the missing girls have been paroled. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Lady Killer
programme.desc: A sexploitation empire is threatened when its nude centerfold models are mysteriously murdered in Lady Killer, on Charlie's Angels.

programme.title: Bullseye
programme.desc: Two Army officers profiting from drug purchases murder in order to protect their scheme as Bullseye airs on Charlie's Angels. A recruit in the Women's Army Corps is shot to death on the firing range and Charlie's Angels are assigned to investigate. Bosley works undercover as a civilian researcher with Sabrina as an Array nurse and Jill and Kelly as new enlistees. A military physician and a cruel drill instructor are discovered to be purchasing large quantities of cheap, inactive drugs and reselling them to the Army at top quality retail prices. Unfortunately, before the Angels can complete their investigation, they become the targets of a search--and-destroy mission. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Consenting Adults
programme.desc: A computer dating service, fronting for prostitutes and their robber accomplices, starts an underworld war by stealing hot diamonds from a syndicate courier in The Consenting Adults on Charlie's Angels. A prostitute supplied by a computer dating service keeps an antique dealer preoccupied while his store is burglarized of priceless art objects. One of the stolen items is a ceramic frog, stuffed with smuggled diamonds -- belonging to a ruthless crime syndicate boss. Thinking he is lying about the thefts, the enraged kingpin kidnaps the antique dealers and Charlie's Angels enter the case. Jill infiltrates the dating service posing as a hooker but finds that the prostitute involved in the burglary has led the crime boss to the diamonds. In a last ditch effort to gain evidence, Angels Sabrina and Jill disguise themselves as veterinarians and steal the syndicate chieftain's championship racehorse. The chieftain agrees to meet the Angels in a park and turn over the diamonds in exchange for his horse. In the exciting climax, Angel Jill must make a getaway with the evidence on her skateboard -- chased by a syndicate hit man Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Night of the Strangler
programme.desc: Kelly is a dead-ringer for a famous (murdered) photographer's model Night of the Strangler on Charlie's Angels. A series of rag doll stranglings brings Charlie's Angels (Kelly, Jill and Sabrina) into the case. Charlie counts on Kelly's resemblance to the first murdered girl to attract the killer. The wife of a well-known fashion designer is the next victim. Narrowing the possibilities, Charlie's Angels date the three most suspect men -- knowing full well one of them is a killer of great ingenuity and imagination. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Jill Munroe and Kelly Garrett, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: The Seance
programme.desc: Rich widows and widowers are hypnotized into thinking their deceased spouses still manage their business affairs from the 'other side' as The Seance airs on Charlie's Angels. A spirited dowager, pressured by insurance investigators about the repeated disappearances of her jewelry, hires Charlie's Angels to solve the mystery. The girls get their first clue when the daffy old lady tells them that her dead husband manages her business affairs from the grave through a medium named Madame Dorian. Kelly assumes the identity of a rich Texas widow; Jill becomes her friend from the 'Lone Star' state and Bosley, their French chauffeur. Unbeknownst to the others, Madame Dorian's male assistant hypnotizes Kelly as he had done with previous widows -- to get financial information from her. During the trance, she reveals her true identity as a private investigator. Realizing that the con game has been uncovered, he programs Kelly to perceive Jill as a childhood bogeyperson, so he can attempt a getaway. The hypnotized Kelly helps in his escape by keeping Charlie's team busy trying to stop her from killing Jill. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Jill Munroe and Kelly Garrett, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Angels on Wheels
programme.desc: Jill becomes the hated star of a roller derby team when she goes undercover to investigate the mysterious death of a beautiful skater as Death on Wheels airs (day/date/time) on Channel 's Charlie's Angels. Skating champ Karen Jason is killed after being forced over the guardrail and into the audience during a rough and tumble race. Charlie's client believes Karen was murdered, despite the police report stating that the death was accidental. In search of clues, Sabrina poses as a state insurance investigator, Kelly as a pushy writer for a national magazine and Jill as a member of the roller derby team. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Jill Munroe and Kelly Garrett, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Angel Trap
programme.desc: Charlie's Angels are summoned to try and stop an assassin intent on killing the members of an old French Underground team in Angel Trap on Charlie's Angels. Fernando Lamas guest stars as Jericho, a paradoxically gentle man with a record of assassination dating back to the days of the World War II French Underground. He becomes the prime suspect when a former member of his old liberationist team is killed. From one of Jericho's ex-girlfriends, Charlie's Angels learn chat he intends to eliminate all of the members of his old French Underground team. In an attempt to capture Jericho before he can carry out his plans, Sabrina poses as the girlfriend of Kamden, the' next likely victim of the team, and Jill sets up an accidental meeting with Jericho. Jill soon finds it difficult to keep her mind on the job as she becomes emotionally involved with the romantic killer. She and Sabrina guess that the probable time and place of Jericho's next move will be in the city park. There, Kelly and an army of police await the inevitable. Jericho arrives in their midst, smiling confidently, carrying his pet kitten. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: The Big Tap Out
programme.desc: Sabrina, Jill and Kelly con a compulsive gambler out of his money in order to trap him in his usual burglary method of replenishing his gambling stakes in The Big Tap Out, on Charlie's Angels. When notorious gambler-thief, Roy David is suspected of burglarizing a securities company of $40,000 to replenish his gambling money, Charlie's Angels are called into the case to obtain the necessary evidence to convict him of the crime. Sabrina and Bosley dupe the gambler into betting nearly half of the loot on a losing horse at the race track. Jill then takes over the scheme at the gambling tables to cheat him out of his remaining money. With David penniless and in desperate need of renewed gambling stakes, the Angels make it easy for him to follow his usual burglary pattern. In front of startled eyes, they carefully, stage a hit-and-run accident in which Jill is apparently killed with detailed floor plans and safe combinations to the casino in her possession. David, of course, steals the plans and immediately sets up a burglary. When David tries to make his getaway from the casino with the stolen money, Kelly stops his escape by ramming her car into the back of his, thereby causing a great commotion into which the police are summoned. On the scene, police discover the cache of stolen money inside David's car, and his gambling days are over. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Angels on a String
programme.desc: Sinister forces attempt to discredit the spokesman for free Poland in Angels on a String, on Charlie's Angels. An international political leader is abducted and a double substituted for him at a world conference being held at a resort where Charlie's Angels are vacationing. Having met the leader earlier, Sabrina knows something is wrong. Soon, the girls discover that the culprits plan to have their importer deliver a false, radicalized, seemingly irrational keynote address. Naturally, the press would misquote him, fatally damaging the cause. Sabrina, disguised as the hotel waitress assigned to serve the imposter, saves the life of our Assistant Secretary to State by switching away a poisoned wineglass. Dressed as a maid, Jill infiltrates the ranks of the phony FBI designated to protect him. Together the girls rescue the real politico in time for his all-important address. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Jill Munroe and Kelly Garrett, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.desc: Charlie's Angels turn the tables on a Las Vegas con artist who blackmails wealthy former chorus girls in The Vegas Connection.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 15 outstanding competitions all over the world, finally we are here at the final competition of this year’s Strongman Champions League hosted in Turkey.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the land of Vikings - Norway - to the first stage of the SCL World Series 2016

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The second stage of the SCL heads to the FIBO convention, Cologne. The leading international trade show for fitness, wellness and health hosts.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the third stage of SCL world series 2016, the athletes compete in Kaunas for the SCL Log Lift World Championships.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stage four is an epic competition and a few surprises. With 14 strongmen from all over the world, one newcomer left quite an impression.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This year Lauri Nami joins the starting list, back after last year's injury in Romania

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL train stopped in Zlatibor for the stage 6 of the MLO SCL. 11 compete for the title in the home country of legendary Ervin Katona.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Bulgaria hosts the next stage of the SCL. Current leader in the World Series is Matjaz Belsak, youngest competitor and strongest man of Slovenia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The competitors battle it out in the special event, the Atlas Steel Stone. This stone is made completely from iron and cannot be touched with any support.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This stage sees the strongmen visit Vaasa, Finland. Residents here are familiar with the competition because some of the SCL icons are from their country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: 38 athletes compete in the under 90kg and under 105kg SCL World Championships. From each weight class, the top 12 qualify for the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A two day, seven event battle with lots of spectators.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Alex Moonen is leading. Part two of the competition in Romania showcases a new challenge - Hercules Hold.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this stage in Curacao no one wants to lose the chance to fight for one kilo gold in World grand finals in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The last chance to qualify for the World Grand Finale. Zageris and Belsak fight for the better position for the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We reach Dubai where we will crown the new champion for SCL 2016. This is part one of the world finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this last episode, the best athletes compete in Pole Push, Deadlift, Forward Hold and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in beautiful Norway for the kick off of the 2017 MLO Strongman Champions League season. With partly cloudy weather and lots of snow, we have the perfect scenery for the athletes, who prepare for the first contest of the year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League heads to Joensuu, Finland, for Stage 7 as athletes battle to be crowned the World’s Strongest Viking 2025. Twelve competitors face nine gruelling events in a high-stakes showdown, with top contenders like Brian Kichton, Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana fighting for crucial championship points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A definite highlight in this FIBO edition in Germany, Strongman Champions League introduced its new rules for a special team item. Graham Hicks tries here to set a New World Record on the biggest log in the world, currently held by Krzysztof Radzikowski. Boosted also by the presence of the acclaimed in the strongman circles names of Mark Felix and Danis Zageris.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This weekend sees the Strongman Champions League Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. Big lifting names such as Graham Hicks , Vidas Blekaitis and Vytatus Lalas are in the startlist to push some big numbers.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous “Black Cross”. The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true ‘heavyweight’. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Situated in the very heart of the Carpathian Mountains, Sibiu is a Romanian town where the climate is pleasantly mild, offering some of the best weather conditions for a strongman event around Europe. All this, without doubt, set the mood for the high results and showtime vibes in Stage 11 of Strongman Champions League. The competition in Sibiu was organized in six different disciplines

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: From now on every stage of these series will be more than crucial. Curacao is a beautiful Dutch island in the Caribbean, with a great atmosphere to hold another stage of the MLO Strongman Champions League. Let’s see who takes the title here and who will secure a place in the next stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Ten of the world’s strongest men gathered in Amman to compete in Jordan’s first-ever Truck-Pull Championship. The contestants race against the clock while pulling a 21-ton truck across the track. One of the most fierce competitors to take part in the event was four-time winner of the World’s Strongest Man competition, Brian Shaw.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Taking place in Corinth, Greece, considered by many the cradle of the sports competition games, an epic strongman battle will mark the last stage before the upcoming big two-day season’s finale in Chetumal, Mexico. In front of more than 5000 spectators, the twelve athletes compete in Log Lifts, Card Deadlift, Conan’s Wheel and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first day of the two-part finale sees the strongest men competing in Carry and Drag, Dumbbell Lift and the Truck Pull. Everything is possible in this heated fight for the crown against the backdrop of stunning Chetumal, Mexico.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On the second day of the grand finale of the 2017 Strongman Champions League, the athletes have a last chance to secure the medals in the spectacular four events Weight for Height, Deadlift Cars, Forward Hold and The Loading Medley. Be prepared for stunning performances – and even world records!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Season 2018 begins with 14 strongest men in the world, all competing for the title. The competition kicks off in Norway. We’ll see typical Viking disciplines, team events and world records in heavy conditions in the land of snow and ice. They will suffer, they will freeze and fight in this first competition of the year for the title that they will carry on their shoulders throughout whole year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capichampions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2018 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time in history, Strongman Champions League will set up competition in Abu Dhabi. The line-up of super athletes, who are part of the SCL, includes former world champions Dainis Zageris (Latvia) And Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland), current world champion Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and biggest strongman in the World Sean O’Hagan (Ireland).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman classic in land where there is no place for anything else excepts strength, fight and endurance. Here are fourteen of the strongest men, fighting for the title of strongest in Holland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We go back to Holland, where former champion Dainis Zageris is in leading position after the first three events. Alongside Radzikowski, he is in this moment favorite for world title, and also leader shirt holder.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stage six of Strongman champions league, 2018 is set back on north, in Finland. Here we have Matjaz Belsak, wearing SCL leader shirt, one of the biggest strongman in the World Mika Torro, fan favorite strongman in all over the World – Will Baggott, and also big name from Baltic – Aivars Smaukstelis

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Twelve strongman, including defending Worldchampion Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia , will compete on “Air spa” for the title of best in homeland country of Tesla, Pupin, Novak Djokovic. Matjaz Belsak is the SCL leader in this competition, chasing his third victory this season.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The World championship in lightweights of the Strongman Champions League bring to us 50 strongmen from all over the world. All athletes are under 105 kilograms and for them this is the step up to the ultimate heavyweights.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Esposende, Portugal, for the World’s Strongest Latino contest. Twelve elite athletes battle through a truck pull, deadlift, log lift, bag toss and medley in front of a packed crowd. Early leader Juan Ferrer sets the pace, as Invernizzi and others fight for top honours.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this second stage of the World championship of lightweights we will find out who out of the 12 athletes will win the title in the under 105 kilogram category.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first part of SCL Romania 2018 will be hosted in Brasov. This episode features a new event for Strongman Champion League: “ The Chopper Pull”!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After three classical Strongman events – Dead lift, Loading and Front hold – and one historical, Chopper Pull for the first time in history of Strongman, now we go to find out who will take title in Romania. This is the second stage in Romania and it remains to be seen who will win the title; Aivars, Travis or Krzyzstof?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next destination of Strongman Champions League is in a piece of paradise on earth – Curacao. We bring to you some special Strongman events like the Rock Lift, Tug of War and Weight for Height in this episode.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This is the last competition before the grand finals. After the first three events Zageris is in top place, but can O’Hagan, Baggott, Petursson and Ortmayer step into the final? Last chance some of them will find through events like Forward Hold, Truck Pull, Dead Lift and loading very big objects.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We bring you 50 minutes of Strongman inside. Fears, inspiration, courage, the best and worst from our finalists and their expectation of the finals. We also go to Poland and Germany to represent one day in the training of Krzysztof Radzikowski and Dennis Kohlruss. See all the finalists for Mexico in their comfort zone here, with their backgrounds /motivations /family and friends.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first part of the Strongman Champions League 2018 finals in Mexico. The last twelve athletes all pushing their boundaries and testing their limits to take the World title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 11 months and 14 competitions all over the world, it all comes down to the final in this episode. The strongmen must show their best skills and every mistake is expensive, so their concentration must be at the highest possible level. Will Krzysztof manage to take off back or will Dainis maintain his lead?

programme.title: Vault
programme.desc: 'Vault' tapahtuu vuonna 1975, ja sen inspiraationa on ollut tositarina eräästä pikkurikollisjoukkiosta, joka teki yhden Yhdysvaltain historian suurimmista ryöstöistä.

programme.title: Tracers
programme.desc: Cam on polkupyörälähetti New Yorkin vaarallisilla kaduilla. Hän selviää kaikesta kahdella pyörällä, mutta velka paikalliselle mafialle pakottaa hänet ottamaan jalat alleen. Hän tapaa sattumalta kauniin ja upean Nikkin, joka johdattaa Camin parkourin lumoavaan ja henkeäsalpaavaan maailmaan.

programme.title: Varkaita ja veijareita
programme.desc: Bud Spencer esittää kovanyrkkistä poliisia, ylikonstaapeli Parkeria, joka saa tehtäväkseen ottaa kiinni lipevän gigolon, Tony Roman. Tony todistaa Mafian tappoiskun.

programme.title: Horizon Line
programme.desc: Ex-pariskunta tapaa vuosien jälkeen osallistuessaan hyvän ystävänsä häihin. Heidän lentäessään trooppiselle saarelle valtameren yli pienellä, yksimoottorisella lentokoneella, pilotti saa kohtalokkaan sydänkohtauksen.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3
programme.desc: Eletään 1600-luvun alkua feodaaliajan Japanissa, ja ratsain kulkeva mies jää vangiksi taistelussaan samurairyhmää vastaan. Vajaat 400 vuotta myöhemmin toimittaja April O’Neil hankkii kirpputorilta lahjoja kilpikonnaystävilleen.

programme.title: The Last Witch Hunter
programme.desc: Monet ovat jahdanneet noitia vuosisatojen ajan eri puolilla maailmaa. Yksi heistä on urhea soturi Kaulder, joka onnistui tappamaan vahvan Kuningatarnoidan ja tuhoamaan samalla tämän joukot...

programme.title: Ben-Hur
programme.desc: Lew Wallacen eeppinen romaani lunastuksesta on tämän innostavan sovituksen sydämessä. Syytetty aatelismies (Jack Huston) selviää vuosien orjuudesta kostaakseen hänet pettäneelle ystävälleen (Toby Kebbell). Elokuvassa nähdään myös Morgan Freeman.

programme.title: Cypher
programme.desc: Yritysvakoilun hämärässä valtakunnassa kyllästynyt jokamies kompastuu petoksen verkkoon ja hänestä tulee tietämätön vakooja. Kun hän navigoi petoksessa ja petoksessa, hän tekee yhteistyötä viettelevän arvoituksen kanssa paljastaakseen järkyttäviä totuuksia ja saadakseen takaisin identiteettinsä.

programme.title: Hamekyttä 2
programme.desc: Hamekytän villissä jatko-osassa Martin Lawrence ja Nia Long palaavatviihdyttämään koko perhettä. Kansakunnan turvallisuus on uhattuna ja FBI-agenttiMalcolm Turner in on jälleen kerran...

programme.title: Legal Action
programme.desc: Lahjakas asianajaja Casey McKay matkustaa ex-vaimonsa kotikaupunkiin puolustamaan tämän veljeä, jota syytetään piirisyyttäjän murhasta. Siellä McKay saa selville salaliiton, joka johtaa hänet avoimeen konfliktiin kaupungin korruptoituneimman rakennuttajan Gatesin kanssa.

programme.title: Max Steel
programme.desc: Suosittuun Mattel-lelusarjaan ja tv-sarjaan perustuen Max Steel on teini-ikäinen uuden sukupolven supersankari, ja elokuvassa toiminta, komedia ja modernit erikoistehosteet muodostavat eeppisen koko perheen seikkailun.

programme.title: The Darkest Hour
programme.desc: Toiminnantäyteisessä sci-fi -trillerissä ryhmä nuoria amerikkalaisia on vierailulla Moskovassa, kun muukalaislaji hyökkää kaupunkiin ja syöksee heidät keskelle epätoivoista selviytymistaistelua.

programme.title: Safe
programme.desc: He tappoivat hänen ystävänsä ja vaimonsa. He uhkasivat tappaa kaikki hänen tulevat tuttavansa. Kun vapaaottelija Luke Wright itsemurhan partaalla näkee samojen venäläisten mafiatyyppien jahtaavan 12-vuotiasta kiinalaista tyttöä, hänellä naksahtaa.

programme.title: The Last Stand
programme.desc: Huumekartellin johtaja karkaa poliisin huostasta ja pakenee kohti Meksikon rajaa, missä paon ainoana esteenä on sheriffi ja hänen kokemattomat alaisensa.

programme.title: The Cold Light Of Day
programme.desc: Nuori liikemies Will Shaw on ansaitulla lomalla vanhempiensa kanssa. Välimerellistä idylliä ei kuitenkaan kestä kauan, kun Willin perhe katoaa: mystistä salkkua jahtaavat agentit sieppaavat muun perheen.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Banaani Joen elämä on yhtä auringonpaistetta. Lokoisaa iloista oloa, ilman stressiä eteläisellä paratiisisaarella, kunnes... Joen asuinkylä on jäämässä modernin business-kulttuurin jalkoihin. Pian paikkaa pyörittävät byrokraatit ja jengit, pykälineen ja paheineen.

programme.title: Renegades
programme.desc: Renegades kertoo Yhdysvaltain laivaston erikoisjoukosta, joka on komennuksella sodan riivaamassa Itä-Euroopassa.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Keskiajan historia kirjoitetaan uudelleen, kun Jamal Walker putoaa Medieval World -teemapuiston vallihautaan ja huomaa siirtyneensä ajassa taaksepäin.

programme.title: Aika ei anna armoa
programme.desc: Denzel Washington on pääosassa tässä mukaansatempaavassa trillerissä. Hän esittää pikkukaupungin poliisipäällikköä, joka joutuu myrskyn silmään tutkiessaan salaa tapailemansa naisen murhaa… koska kaikki todisteet viittaavat häneen!

programme.title: Turpiin vaan ja onnea
programme.desc: Tavanomaista Spencer - Hill -mättöä. Matt Kirby ja Wilbur Walsh (Hill And Spencer) ovat hieman aggressiivisia luonteita ja joutuvatkin usein vaikeuksiin, joista kuitenkin yleensä selviytyvät nyrkkiensä avulla.

programme.title: Bandidas
programme.desc: 1800-luvun lopun Meksiko on todellinen paheiden pesä, jossa raha sanelee säännöt. Sara on rikkaan pankkiirin tytär, kun taas Maria on köyhä talonpoikaisnainen.

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Bob Ho on kansainvälinen agentti, joka on ollut mukana vaikka missä: takaa-ajoissa, räjähdyksissä, putoamisissa. Ne eivät kuitenkaan ole mitään verrattuna hänenseuraavaan tehtäväänsä: hänen pitää hoitaa tyttöystävänsä kolmea kakaraa!

programme.title: Varkaita ja veijareita
programme.desc: Bud Spencer esittää kovanyrkkistä poliisia, ylikonstaapeli Parkeria, joka saa tehtäväkseen ottaa kiinni lipevän gigolon, Tony Roman. Tony todistaa Mafian tappoiskun.

programme.title: Senkka nenästä pojat!
programme.desc: Järjestäytyneen rikollisuuden vedonlyöjät, korttihait ja huijarit piinaavat toimillaan Miamia, ja poliisin johto on päättänyt ottaa kovat keinot käyttöön ja puhdistaa kaupungin.

programme.title: Van Veeteren: Pääsky, kissa, ruusu, kuolema
programme.desc: Van Veeteren –elokuvat perustuvat Håkan Nesserin menestysromaaneihin.

programme.title: Collide
programme.desc: Nuori amerikkalainen reppumatkaaja Casey rakastuu Saksassa amerikkalaiseen Julietteen, joka myös kiertää Eurooppaa. Kun Juliettella todetaan vakava sairaus, Casey päättää varastaa saksalaisgangsteri Hagenilta maksaakseen hoidon, joka voi pelastaa tytön hengen.

programme.title: Kill
programme.desc: Erikoisjoukkojen sotilas Amrit saa tietää, että hänen rakastettunsa Tulika on kihlattu toiselle vasten tahtoaan. Hän lähtee junalla New Delhiin estämään järjestetyn avioliiton, mutta aseistettu rosvojoukko alkaa terrorisoida matkustajia.

programme.title: Safe
programme.desc: He tappoivat hänen ystävänsä ja vaimonsa. He uhkasivat tappaa kaikki hänen tulevat tuttavansa. Kun vapaaottelija Luke Wright itsemurhan partaalla näkee samojen venäläisten mafiatyyppien jahtaavan 12-vuotiasta kiinalaista tyttöä, hänellä naksahtaa.

programme.title: Turpiin vaan ja tuplaten
programme.desc: Kaksoisolentojen välittämiseen erikoistunut yritys saa tilauksen kahdelta äärimmäisen vaikutusvaltaiselta liikemieheltä sijaistensa etsimiseksi. Hätiin löytyvät saksofonisti Greg ja surffaaja Eliot.

programme.title: World Heritage
programme.desc: While the Pyramids of Giza, built as a royal mortuary, reveal the religious beliefs of Egyptian pharaohs, temples, like the Luxor temple, offer a glimpse of ancient Egyptian mythology. The Saladin Citadel, which defines the skyline of Cairo, however, tells stories of the faith of Ottoman rulers. The monuments of Egypt are a testament to the different beliefs that have shaped this country.

programme.title: 10 Days Scotland
programme.desc: Robbie’s adventures in Perth kick off with him immersing himself in the historic grandeur of the Scone Castle, where a mysterious stone tells tales of Scottish monarchs. But the real thunder of the Highlands awaits at the Braemar Games gathering, where tartan meets brawn, and Robbie learns that embracing his Scottish side involves more than just kilts and castles.

programme.title: Backpack Serbia
programme.desc: Heather explores Novi Sad, the financial and industrial hub of Serbia.Starting with canoeing on Danube and later exploring the city and its landmarks.

programme.title: Boarding Pass
programme.desc: Emeline Nsingi Nkosi goes to Santa Village at Rovaniemi, where she reads some of the letters that children from around the world write to him.

programme.title: Xplore Bulgaria
programme.desc: Luxurious hotels, thrilling water parks, inexpensive food and almost 300 days of bright sunny weather make Bulgaria’s biggest seaside resort, Sunny Beach popular for budget beach getaways. Catriona, however, stumbles onto the historic town of Nessebar, which is over 3000 years old, and realizes that there is more to the place than meets the eye. She goes on to visit the Castra Rubra winery, where she finds out about the history of Viticulture in Bulgaria and the process of wine making.

programme.desc: Benafsha embarks on a whirlwind adventure in Ahmedabad. With just 48 hours in the city, she is determined to make the most of it, but how?

programme.title: Food Fact Fun
programme.desc: From exploring a vintage car museum to scaling a 5 meter ice-wall and sampling a rich bread cookie, Watch Alex exploring The Hague, also known as the “International city of peace”.

programme.title: 10 Days Scotland
programme.desc: A modern European oil city built on the back of a rich maritime heritage, Aberdeen is the energetic kingpin of northeast Scotland. While the boom times may come and go, the dynamic coastal metropolis never ceases to thrill with its free museums, outdoor adventures and natural attractions right on the city’s doorstep.

programme.title: Backpack Serbia
programme.desc: Heather explores Požarevac and visits the ancient town of Viminacium. Later visits National Museum, concluding with Majdanpek’s Rajkova Pecina Caves.

programme.desc: Emeline Nsingi Nkosi goes to Rovaniemi, where she visits a husky farm and finds out about about breeding and raising huskies.

programme.title: Xplore Bulgaria
programme.desc: For the people of Sofia, preserving its heritage is sacrosanct, and this can be seen in the way the city's infrastructure is built around its archeological treasures. Catriona realizes this when she roams around the cobblestone streets of the city. With every monument she visits, she finds herself transported to a different era, right from Perperikon fort, which narrate stories of the Byzantine empire, to Boyana church, which is home to some of the earliest examples of medieval artwork.

Along the way, she finds out the secrets to the quintessential Bhutanese peace and contentment.

programme.title: Xplore Bhutan
programme.desc: Known as Druk Yul or the “Land of the Thunder Dragon”, Bhutan is the country of mountains, monasteries and mystery. Radhika Bangia finds this to be true when she visits Punakha, the former capital of Bhutan, where she marvels at the architecture of Punakha Dzong and gets to know the story behind the two rivers, Mo Chhu and Po Chhu. She also explores the sacred temples and Mebar Tsho lake of Bumthang, the religious heart of Bhutan, and gets to know the local legends.

programme.title: 10 Days Scotland
programme.desc: Robbie’s journey to reconnect with his Scottish roots begins in Edinburgh, the stunning capital city perched on extinct volcanoes. Navigating the twists of the Royal Mile, strutting around the majestic Edinburgh castle and learning to sip scotch like a true Scotsman, he feels a tad closer to his heritage. The real fun kicks in, however, when he stumbles onto a rather flamboyant way to unleash his inner Highlander.

programme.title: Xplore Bulgaria
programme.desc: Like Rome, Plovdiv straddles seven hills; but as Europe’s oldest continuously inhabited city, it’s far more ancient. As Catriona takes a tour of the city to see its iconic attractions such as a Roman Amphitheatre, which was once the setting for gladiator fights, and the striking Baroque Saints Constantine and Helena Church, she begins to see how seamlessly modern life blends with the age-old ruins. Along the way, she realizes why Plovdiv is called the ‘Eternal City’ of Bulgaria.
